title: Strix
tagline: Open-source autonomous AI penetration testing agents that find and fix app vulnerabilities with real exploit validation.
summary: Strix is an open-source AI penetration testing tool that deploys autonomous AI hacker agents to dynamically execute code, discover vulnerabilities, and validate findings through real proof-of-concept exploits. Built for developers and security teams, Strix features multi-agent orchestration, full pentest toolkits (recon, exploit, validation), auto-patch generation, compliance-ready reporting, and seamless CI/CD pipeline integration.
highlights: Autonomous AI pentesting agents executing dynamic security analysis and multi-agent team orchestration
Real exploit validation generating working PoCs to eliminate false positives found in static analysis tools
Full application security pipeline with recon, exploit, auto-patch generation, compliance reports, and CI/CD scan hooks
